notes: One lap of the Paris finishing circuit in the race direction, taken from tour26-21 (its second Champs lap, waypoints 120-145, finish line to finish line): up the Champs-Élysées, round the Arc de Triomphe on Place Charles de Gaulle, down the Champs-Élysées to Place de la Concorde, across its north side into the Rue de Rivoli EASTBOUND, right at Place des Pyramides into the Avenue du Général-Lemonnier and through the tunnel under the Tuileries, out at the Pont Royal onto the Quai Aimé-Césaire / Quai des Tuileries WESTBOUND along the Seine, across the south side of Place de la Concorde and up the Champs-Élysées to the line. km 0 = the finish line on the uphill side, ~0.7 km above Concorde (tour26-21's line position). Overture maps the Champs-Élysées as one centre line, so up and down share it (validate.py allows that for this route). [geodata G: rebuilt by the pipeline from tour26-21 on the coordinator's instruction; the earlier file (researcher, kept in wp_backup) ran the Tuileries loop the other way round (quai eastbound, Lemonnier, Rivoli westbound) and started at Place Clemenceau.]
